image_description: A low-angle, wide-shot of a rock band performing on an outdoor festival stage. Three musicians are visible: a vocalist in a white hoodie on the left, a bassist in a leather jacket and hat in the center, and a guitarist on the right. The stage features a metal truss roof structure with hanging lights and bunting flags. Large black stage monitors (wedges) are in the foreground. The lighting is dramatic with strong backlighting creating lens flare.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the red and white box in the bottom center ('ASTRA'?) and the logo on the left speaker are slightly distorted and lack the crisp edges of real printed text, typical of AI generation.
The central musician's left hand on the bass guitar neck appears fused with the fretboard; fingers are indistinct. The right musician's hand on the guitar body is also poorly defined.
The microphone grille lacks distinct mesh texture and seems to blend into the singer's mouth area. Skin texture is overly smooth/plastic-like compared to the leather jacket.
